mapper.select: SELECT context_json,state_json FROM agent_expense_orchestration WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND handling_id=#{task} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,handling_id FROM agent_expense_orchestration WHERE status IN ('READY','TOOL_READY','WAITING_CHILD') OR (status IN ('MODEL_RUNNING','TOOL_RUNNING') AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY checked_at,id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_expense_orchestration SET checked_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND handling_id=#{task}
UPDATE agent_expense_orchestration SET version=#{version},status=#{status},lease_until=#{lease},state_json=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{previous}
mapper.select: SELECT handling_id,report_id,application_version,financial_version FROM agent_handling_child WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND child_id=#{child} AND kind=#{kind}
